alternatives.label: Culture, communication and social sustainability
alternatives.concept: A broad UCR response studies culture and its material heritage, language and media, intercultural communication, social relationships, environmental history and climate communication through empirical and humanities methods. It does not provide the 30-EC French language-and-culture sequence chosen in the Radboud comparator.
alternatives.labelReason: The course mix visibly combines cultural study, communication and social sustainability rather than implying French, German or Spanish language proficiency.
progression: Introductory cultural, communication, media, social and sustainability courses precede advanced theory and practical work; prerequisites and term availability are satisfied.

alternatives.label: Environmental culture, communication and sustainability
alternatives.concept: Investigate cultural interpretations and public responses to climate change through environmental media, museums, social theory, ethical reasoning and communication. Ecology, water management, nature-based intervention and renewable-system design provide specific scientific and practical complements. General ethical theory is not a dedicated environmental-ethics course. The full external pathway and final comparability remain unverified.
alternatives.labelReason: The actual curriculum combines cultural/media/social study with environmental science and practical design. Its label and concept preserve that broad composition without claiming every selected course is environmental humanities.
progression: Sustainability Essentials I precedes II, which precedes Renewable System Design; the other selected courses satisfy their formal prerequisites and scheduled terms.
alternatives.distinctness: Relative to the cultural-communication route, this route retains 5 different courses in sustainability foundations, water, ecosystems and renewable-system design. The shared museum course strengthens cultural interpretation; it does not replace partner-led delta research with a claim of equivalent research.

candidates.label: Multilingual language proficiency and international communication
candidates.reason: UCR teaches interpretation, communication and one introductory Dutch language course, but no multisemester foreign-language proficiency sequence that could underpin a distinct language-focused 24-course programme.

candidates.label: French-language societies and cultures
candidates.reason: UCR offers cultural/heritage comparisons but no French language acquisition or advanced Francophone regional-studies sequence.

candidates.label: German-language societies and cultures
candidates.reason: UCR offers European history and cultural analysis but no German language acquisition or advanced Germanophone regional-studies sequence.

candidates.label: Spanish-speaking societies and cultures
candidates.reason: UCR offers global cultural analysis but no Spanish language acquisition or advanced Hispanic/Latin American studies sequence.

routeSelection.route: Ordinary non-abroad specialisation with French language-and-culture minors
routeSelection.basis: The target itself is the named Society, Language and Culture specialisation. The non-abroad third-year route is the ordinary first-listed route; among equal language-area minors the official page lists French first. This neutral tie-break does not consider UCR course availability. The 30-EC third-year free space remains open.

selection.assessment: Two stored concepts remain provisional pending the complete verified external pathway and weighted comparability review. Offering conflict repaired by substituting current museum/institutional interpretation for unavailable delta research, narrowing the contribution rather than asserting equivalent research. No final alternative approval or no-match conclusion. Current partial relationships reconsidered: academic-writing methods align with PPD, environmental representation with Media and the Environment, conversation-analysis and prospective Environmental Ethics remain unmatched. No final alternative or stopping approval.

notes.text: Radboud combines social and environmental sustainability with 30 EC in one chosen French, German or Spanish language-and-culture area and a partner-linked cultural capstone. UCR can build coherent culture, communication and sustainability programmes but does not teach those required foreign-language sequences, so no UCR course or general intercultural study is presented as their equivalent.

audience.programmeDescription: Radboud Society, Language and Culture studies social and environmental sustainability through language, communication and cultural perspectives. Students study a chosen language and cultural region and work on societal projects.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The full curriculum and final research requirements are still being verified. Only the verified required study is shown here. A UCR comparison is awaiting completion of that review.

curriculum.routeLabel: Ordinary full-time specialisation; required first- and second-year study
curriculum.limitation: The displayed components total 90 EC and do not constitute a complete degree pathway. A further 30 EC of language-and-culture minors must be taken in one language. Their detailed conditions, the third-year allocation and final-work requirements remain under review. Third-year prospective information is indicative.
